4. MOUSE(row=16, col=38) - N=4, G=1 → N=3, G=0 (deselects, one more N disappears)

- Click on a cross to select it (G appears)
- Click on an empty cell to deselect and remove one cross (N decreases)

- Eventually, clicking on the last remaining cross removes ALL crosses

- Click on an empty cell when something is selected → deselect and remove the selected cross
- Click on an empty cell when nothing is selected → select that empty cell (G=1)

<function=python>

# Current state: N=5, G=0 (all crosses present, none selected)
